// Buff Code: runner of a script connection. Written by Buff Code, do not edit.
// Usage: buff _runner.mjs <script.ts>  — the script exports `tools` (and optionally `instructions`).
// Speaks MCP over stdio: newline-delimited JSON-RPC; initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call.
const file = process.argv[2]
if (!file) {
  process.stderr.write("usage: _runner.mjs <script>\n")
  process.exit(2)
}
// Путь к скрипту — абсолютным файлом: относительный bun принял бы за имя пакета.
const { pathToFileURL } = await import("node:url")
const { resolve } = await import("node:path")
const module = await import(pathToFileURL(resolve(file)).href)
const tools = Array.isArray(module.tools) ? module.tools : Array.isArray(module.default) ? module.default : []
const instructions = typeof module.instructions === "string" ? module.instructions : undefined
const write = (message) => process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(message) + "\n")
const reply = (id, result) => write({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id, result })
const refuse = (id, code, message) => write({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id, error: { code, message } })
const text = (value) => (typeof value === "string" ? value : JSON.stringify(value, null, 2))

const handle = async (message) => {
  const { id, method, params } = message
  if (method === "initialize")
    return reply(id, {
      protocolVersion: params?.protocolVersion ?? "2025-06-18",
      capabilities: { tools: {} },
      serverInfo: { name: "buff-script-connection", version: "1" },
      ...(instructions ? { instructions } : {}),
    })
  if (method === "ping") return reply(id, {})
  if (method === "tools/list")
    return reply(id, {
      tools: tools.map((tool) => ({
        name: tool.name,
        description: tool.description ?? "",
        inputSchema: tool.input ?? { type: "object", properties: {} },
      })),
    })
  if (method === "tools/call") {
    const tool = tools.find((item) => item.name === params?.name)
    if (!tool) return refuse(id, -32602, `Unknown tool: ${params?.name}`)
    try {
      const value = await tool.run(params?.arguments ?? {})
      const structured = value !== null && typeof value === "object" ? { structuredContent: value } : {}
      return reply(id, { content: [{ type: "text", text: text(value ?? "") }], ...structured, isError: false })
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
      return reply(id, { content: [{ type: "text", text: message }], isError: true })
    }
  }
  if (id === undefined) return
  refuse(id, -32601, `Method not found: ${method}`)
}

let buffer = ""
process.stdin.setEncoding("utf8")
process.stdin.on("data", (chunk) => {
  buffer += chunk
  let at
  while ((at = buffer.indexOf("\n")) >= 0) {
    const line = buffer.slice(0, at).trim()
    buffer = buffer.slice(at + 1)
    if (!line) continue
    let message
    try {
      message = JSON.parse(line)
    } catch {
      continue
    }
    void handle(message)
  }
})
process.stdin.on("end", () => process.exit(0))
